items.title: TJX Companies (TJX) Faces Questions After Marmaxx Posted 1% Comparable Sales Growth
items.summary: TJX Companies (NYSE:TJX) drew fresh attention after Jim Cramer questioned execution issues in its Marmaxx division on recent results. Marmaxx, which includes TJ Maxx and Marshalls, reported 1% comparable sales growth that Cramer contrasted with a stronger key rival. TJX executives acknowledged self-inflicted merchandising and execution problems at Marmaxx and stated these have been fixed without outlining specific actions. The concerns Cramer raised about Marmaxx execution now intersect with...

items.summary: Ross Stores and Target are drawing shoppers from rivals as consumers hunt for value. New traffic data show which discounters are gaining ground.

items.title: TJX Raises Fiscal 2027 Outlook as Q2 Results Show Broad-Based Growth
